name: +1 Armor
description: You have a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wearing this armor, in addition to the armor's normal AC.

name: +1 Shield
description: While holding this magic shield, you have a +1 bonus to Armor Class in addition to the shield's normal AC bonus.

name: +1 Weapon
description: You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: Adamantine Armor
description: This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine. While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.

name: Alchemy Jug
description: This ceramic jug weighs 12 pounds whether full or empty. You can take a Magic Action to name one liquid (acid, basic poison, beer, honey, mayonnaise, oil, vinegar, water, or wine) and cause the jug to produce it once per day. You can then uncork the jug and pour out up to 2 gallons per minute. Quantities per use: acid 8 oz, basic poison ½ oz, beer 4 gal, honey 1 gal, mayonnaise/vinegar 2 gal, oil 1 qt, water 8 gal, wine 1 gal.

name: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location
description: While wearing this amulet, you are hidden from divination magic. You can't be targeted by such magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

name: Bag of Beans
description: Inside this heavy cloth bag are 3d4 dry beans. If you dump the bag's contents out, they explode in a 10-foot radius (DC 15 Dexterity, 5d4 Fire). If you plant and water one bean, a random effect sprouts after 1 minute — results range from a harmless mushroom or campfire to a treant or geyser. Eating a raw bean causes a Fireball centred on you (5d4 Fire, DC 15 Dex).

name: Bag of Devouring
description: This bag resembles a Bag of Holding and radiates a faint conjuration aura. Any object placed inside has a 50% chance of vanishing into the Astral Plane. Any Small or smaller creature placed inside is transported to the Astral Plane (DC 15 Strength to escape before the bag closes). A DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check identifies it as a Bag of Devouring.

name: Bag of Holding
description: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions (roughly 2 feet in diameter, 4 feet deep). It can hold up to 500 pounds not exceeding 64 cubic feet, and always weighs 15 pounds. Retrieving an item requires a Magic Action. Breathing creatures inside begin to suffocate after 10 minutes. If overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is destroyed.

name: Bag of Tricks (Gray)
description: This gray cloth bag has 3 charges (resets daily at dawn). You can take a Magic Action to pull a fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When it lands, it transforms into a creature: d8 — 1 Weasel, 2 Giant Rat, 3 Badger, 4 Boar, 5 Panther, 6 Giant Badger, 7 Dire Wolf, 8 Giant Elk. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it drops to 0 Hit Points.

name: Bag of Tricks (Rust)
description: This rust-colored cloth bag has 3 charges (resets daily at dawn). You can take a Magic Action to pull a fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When it lands, it transforms into a creature: d8 — 1 Rat, 2 Owl, 3 Mastiff, 4 Goat, 5 Giant Goat, 6 Giant Boar, 7 Lion, 8 Brown Bear. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it drops to 0 Hit Points.

name: Bag of Tricks (Tan)
description: This tan cloth bag has 3 charges (resets daily at dawn). You can take a Magic Action to pull a fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When it lands, it transforms into a creature: d8 — 1 Jackal, 2 Ape, 3 Baboon, 4 Axe Beak, 5 Black Bear, 6 Giant Weasel, 7 Giant Hyena, 8 Tiger. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it drops to 0 Hit Points.

name: Berserker Axe
description: Cursed. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Curse: once attuned, you are cursed. When combat begins, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to attack the nearest creature each turn until it is Incapacitated or dead. Only a Remove Curse spell ends the attunement.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

name: Boots of Striding and Springing
description: While you wear these boots, your walking Speed becomes 30 feet (unless it is higher), and your Speed isn't reduced if you are encumbered or wearing heavy armor. In addition, you can jump three times the normal distance, though you can't jump farther than your remaining movement would allow.

name: Boots of the Winterlands
description: While you wear these boots, you have Resistance to Cold damage, you ignore Difficult Terrain created by ice or snow, and you can tolerate temperatures as low as −50 degrees Fahrenheit without additional protection.

name: Bracers of Archery
description: While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the longbow and shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls on ranged attacks made with such weapons.

name: Brooch of Shielding
description: While wearing this brooch, you have Resistance to Force damage and Immunity to damage from the Magic Missile spell.

name: Broom of Flying
description: While holding this broom, you can take a Magic Action to speak its command word, causing it to hover and carry you at a Fly Speed of 50 feet (30 feet while carrying over 200 lbs; max 400 lbs). It stops hovering when you land. You can send it to travel alone by giving a simple command; it travels at 20 mph and returns when you call it.

name: Candle of the Deep
description: The flame of this candle is not extinguished when immersed in water. It gives off light and heat like a normal candle.

name: Cap of Water Breathing
description: While wearing this cap underwater, you can take a Magic Action to speak its command word, creating a bubble of air around your head that lets you breathe normally underwater. The bubble remains until you speak the command word again, the cap is removed, or you are no longer underwater.

name: Circlet of Blasting
description: While wearing this circlet, you can take a Magic Action to cast the Scorching Ray spell with it (attack bonus +5). The circlet can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

name: Cloak of Billowing
description: While wearing this cloak, you can use a Bonus Action to make it billow dramatically.

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
description: While you wear this cloak with its hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide. The cloak's color shifts to camouflage you. Pulling the hood up or down requires a Magic Action.

name: Cloak of Many Fashions
description: While wearing this cloak, you can use a Bonus Action to change the style, color, and apparent quality of the garment. The cloak's weight doesn't change, and it can't duplicate the properties of other magic cloaks.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
description: While wearing this cloak with its hood up, you can breathe underwater and you have a Swim Speed of 60 feet. Pulling the hood up or down requires a Magic Action.

name: Clothes of Mending
description: This outfit of traveler's clothes magically mends itself over the course of 1 hour after being torn, burned, or otherwise damaged in a mundane way.

name: Dark Shard Amulet
description: While wearing it, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your warlock spells. Once per long rest, you can try to cast a warlock cantrip you don't know: make a DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, the cantrip is cast; on a failure, the spell fails and the Magic Action is wasted.

name: Decanter of Endless Water
description: You can take a Magic Action to remove the stopper and speak one of three command words to pour out fresh or salt water. Stream: 1 gallon. Fountain: 5 gallons. Geyser: 30 gallons in a 30-foot line (DC 13 Strength save or knocked Prone, 1d4 Bludgeoning to creatures it hits). The water vanishes after 1 minute.

name: Dread Helm
description: This fearsome steel helm makes your eyes glow red while you wear it.

name: Dust of Disappearance
description: Found in a small packet (one use). When you take a Magic Action to throw the dust into the air, you and each creature and object within 10 feet of you become Invisible for 2d4 minutes. The duration is the same for all subjects, and the dust is consumed when its magic takes effect.

name: Dust of Dryness
description: This small packet contains 1d6 + 4 pinches of dust. You can take a Magic Action to sprinkle a pinch over water, turning a 15-foot cube of water into a marble-sized pellet. A creature can use an action to smash the pellet, releasing the water. If sprinkled on a water elemental, it takes 10d6 Necrotic damage (DC 13 Constitution save for half).

name: Dust of Sneezing and Choking
description: Appears identical to Dust of Disappearance (one use). When you take a Magic Action to throw a handful into the air, each creature within 30 feet that needs to breathe must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be Incapacitated for 1 minute, spending its turns sneezing. A creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Ear Horn of Hearing
description: While held up to your ear, this horn suppresses the effects of the Deafened condition on you, allowing you to hear normally.

name: Efficient Quiver
description: Each of the quiver's three extradimensional compartments holds numerous items while always weighing only 2 lbs: shortest holds 60 arrows or bolts; middle holds 18 javelins; longest holds 6 bows, staves, or spears. You can draw any item from it as if from a regular quiver.

name: Ersatz Eye
description: This artificial eye replaces a real one that was lost or removed. While it is embedded in your eye socket, it can't be removed by anyone other than you, and you can see through it as though it were a normal eye.

name: Eversmoking Bottle
description: Smoke leaks from around the stopper. When you take a Magic Action to remove the stopper, a cloud of thick smoke pours out in a 60-foot radius (heavily obscured). The radius grows by 10 feet each minute the stopper is off, to a maximum of 120 feet. Replacing the stopper causes the smoke to disperse after 10 minutes. High wind disperses it after 1 minute.

name: Eyes of Charming
description: These crystal lenses have 3 charges. While wearing them, you can expend 1 charge as a Magic Action to cast Charm Person (save DC 13) on a humanoid within 30 feet that you can see. The lenses regain all expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Eyes of Minute Seeing
description: While wearing these crystal lenses, you can see much better than normal out to a range of 1 foot. You have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks that rely on sight while searching an area or studying an object within that range.

name: Eyes of the Eagle
description: While wearing these crystal lenses, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. In conditions of clear visibility, you can make out details of even extremely distant creatures and objects as small as 2 feet across.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
description: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is already 19 or higher.

name: Gem of Brightness
description: This prism has 50 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic Action to speak one of three command words: 1st (1 charge) sheds bright light 30 ft / dim light 30 ft; 2nd (2 charges) fires a beam — one creature within 60 ft makes DC 15 Constitution save or is Blinded 1 minute; 3rd (5 charges) flashes a 30-ft cone — same save. The gem becomes nonmagical when its last charge is expended.

name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
description: When a ranged weapon attack hits you while wearing these gloves, you can use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier, provided you have a free hand. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the missile if it is small enough to hold in that hand.

name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
description: While wearing these gloves, climbing and swimming don't cost you extra movement, and you gain a +5 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb or swim.

name: Gloves of Thievery
description: These gloves are invisible while worn. While wearing them, you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and Dexterity checks made to pick locks.

name: Goggles of Night
description: While wearing these dark lenses, you have Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

name: Hat of Disguise
description: While wearing this hat, you can take a Magic Action to cast the Disguise Self spell from it at will. The spell ends if the hat is removed.

name: Hat of Vermin
description: This hat has 3 charges. While holding the hat, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge and speak a command word, summoning your choice of a bat, a frog, or a rat. The creature appears in the hat, is not under your control, and vanishes after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points. The hat regains all expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Hat of Wizardry
description: While wearing it, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your wizard spells. Once per long rest, you can try to cast a wizard cantrip you don't know: make a DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, the cantrip is cast; on a failure, the spell fails and the Magic Action is wasted.

name: Headband of Intellect
description: Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is already 19 or higher.

name: Helm of Comprehending Languages
description: While wearing this helm, you can take a Magic Action to cast the Comprehend Languages spell from it at will.

name: Helm of Telepathy
description: While wearing this helm, you can take a Magic Action to cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 13). While concentrating, you can use a Bonus Action to send a telepathic message to the focused creature; it can reply as a Bonus Action. While focused, you can take a Magic Action to cast Suggestion (save DC 13) on that creature (once per dawn).

name: Heward's Handy Spice Pouch
description: This belt pouch has 10 charges. While holding the pouch, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge, speak the name of any nonmagical spice, and produce a pinch of that spice in your hand. The pouch regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Horn of Silent Alarm
description: This horn has 4 charges. When you take a Magic Action to blow it, one creature of your choice within 600 feet that isn't Deafened hears the horn's blare; no other creature hears the sound. The horn regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Immovable Rod
description: This flat iron rod has a button on one end. You can take a Magic Action to press the button, causing the rod to become magically fixed in place until you or another creature uses a Magic Action to press the button again. The rod holds up to 8,000 pounds; more weight causes it to fall. A creature can use an action to make a DC 30 Strength check, moving the rod up to 10 feet on a success.

name: Instrument of Illusions
description: While you are playing this musical instrument, you can create harmless illusory visual effects within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on the instrument (15-foot radius if you are a Bard). The magical effects have neither substance nor sound and are obviously illusory. The effects end when you stop playing.

name: Instrument of Scribing
description: This musical instrument has 3 charges. While playing it, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge and write a magical message of up to six words (in a language you know) on a nonmagical object or surface you can see within 30 feet. The message fades after 24 hours or when someone reads it. The instrument regains all charges daily at dawn.

name: Javelin of Lightning
description: This javelin is a magic weapon. When you hurl it and speak its command word, it transforms into a bolt of lightning, forming a 5-foot-wide line that extends out to 120 feet. Each creature in the line (excluding you) must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. The javelin then returns to its non-magical form.

name: Keoghtom's Ointment
description: This glass jar contains 1d4+1 doses of a thick mixture that smells faintly of aloe and cinnamon. As a Magic Action, you can swallow a dose or apply it to the skin of a creature, restoring 2d8+2 Hit Points to that creature and ending any disease or the Poisoned condition affecting it.

name: Lantern of Revealing
description: While lit, this hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Invisible creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the lantern's bright light. You can take a Magic Action to lower the hood, reducing the light to dim light in a 5-foot radius.

name: Lock of Trickery
description: This lock appears to be an ordinary padlock. Whenever a creature other than you attempts to pick it using thieves' tools, that creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity check. On a failed check, the creature believes it has picked the lock, though the lock remains locked.

name: Medallion of Thoughts
description: The medallion has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge and cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 13). The medallion regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Mithral Armor
description: Mithral is a light, flexible metal. If the armor normally imposes Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version doesn't. Any class can wear it without proficiency.

name: Moon-Touched Sword
description: In darkness, the unsheathed blade of this sword sheds moonlight, creating Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet. The sword is considered a magic weapon.

name: Mystery Key
description: A question mark is worked into the head of this key. The key has a 5 percent chance of unlocking any lock into which it's inserted. Once it unlocks something, the key disappears.

name: Necklace of Adaptation
description: While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have Advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as those created by Cloudkill, Stinking Cloud, and inhaled poisons).

name: Necklace of Fireballs
description: This necklace has 1d6+3 beads hanging from it. You can use a Magic Action to detach a bead and throw it up to 60 feet; it explodes as a 3rd-level Fireball (DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, 8d6 Fire damage). You can hurl multiple beads simultaneously, increasing the Fireball's level by 1 for each bead beyond the first.

name: Oil of Slipperiness
description: This sticky black unguent has two uses. If applied to a creature over 10 minutes, that creature gains the effect of the Freedom of Movement spell for 8 hours. Alternatively, it can be poured on the ground as a Magic Action, covering a 10-foot square. Any creature on that surface must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone. The oil dries after 1 hour.

name: Orb of Direction
description: While holding this orb, you can take a Magic Action to determine which way is north. This property functions only on the Material Plane.

name: Orb of Time
description: While holding this orb, you can take a Magic Action to determine whether it is morning, afternoon, evening, or nighttime outside. This property functions only on the Material Plane.

name: Pearl of Power
description: While this pearl is on your person, you can take a Magic Action to speak its command word and regain one expended spell slot. If the expended slot was of 4th level or higher, the new slot is 3rd level. Once you use the pearl, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Perfume of Bewitching
description: This tiny vial contains magic perfume, enough for one use. You can take a Magic Action to apply the perfume to yourself; its effect lasts 1 hour. For the duration, you have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to influence the attitude of humanoids.

name: Periapt of Health
description: You are immune to contracting any disease while you wear this pendant. If you are already infected with a disease, the effects of the disease are suppressed while you wear it.

name: Periapt of Proof against Poison
description: This delicate silver chain has a brilliant-cut black gem pendant. While you wear it, you are immune to the Poisoned condition and have Immunity to Poison damage.

name: Periapt of Wound Closure
description: While you wear this pendant, you stabilize whenever you are dying at the start of your turn. In addition, whenever you roll a Hit Die to regain Hit Points, double the number of Hit Points it restores.

name: Philter of Love
description: The next time you see a creature within 10 minutes of drinking this potion, you become Charmed by that creature for 1 hour. If the creature is of a species and gender you are normally attracted to, you regard it as your true love while Charmed. The creature is unaware of the effect.

name: Pipe of Smoke Monsters
description: While smoking this pipe, you can use a Bonus Action to exhale a puff of smoke that takes the form of a single creature small enough to fit in a 1-foot cube. The form loses its shape after a few seconds, becoming an ordinary puff of smoke.

name: Pipes of Haunting
description: Requires proficiency with wind instruments. This instrument has 3 charges. You can take a Magic Action to play it and expend 1 charge to create an eerie tune: each creature within 30 feet that hears you play must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened of you for 1 minute. On a success, it is immune to this effect for 24 hours. The pipes regain 1d3 charges daily at dawn.

name: Pipes of the Sewers
description: Requires proficiency with wind instruments. While attuned, ordinary rats and giant rats are indifferent toward you. The pipes have 3 charges. If you play the pipes as a Magic Action, you can use a Bonus Action to expend 1–3 charges, calling forth one Swarm of Rats per charge within 30 feet. The swarms obey you. The pipes regain 1d3 charges daily at dawn.

name: Pole of Angling
description: While holding this 10-foot pole, you can take a Magic Action to speak a command word and transform it into a fishing rod with a hook, a line, and a reel. Speaking the command word again changes it back into a 10-foot pole.

name: Pole of Collapsing
description: While holding this 10-foot pole, you can take a Magic Action to speak a command word and cause it to collapse into a 1-foot-long rod for easy storage. The pole elongates back to 10 feet as a Bonus Action or when you drop it.

name: Pot of Awakening
description: If you plant an ordinary shrub in this 10-pound clay pot and let it grow for 30 days, the shrub magically transforms into an Awakened Shrub at the end of that time. When the shrub awakens, the pot cracks and becomes nonmagical.

name: Potion of Animal Friendship
description: When you drink this potion, you can cast Animal Friendship (save DC 13) for 1 hour at will. Agitating this muddy liquid brings little bits into view: a fish scale, a hummingbird tongue, a cat claw, or a squirrel hair.

name: Potion of Fire Breath
description: After drinking this potion, you can use a Bonus Action to exhale fire at a target within 30 feet of you. The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. The effect ends after you exhale fire three times or after 1 hour.

name: Potion of Giant Strength (Hill)
description: When you drink this potion, your Strength score becomes 21 for 1 hour. If your Strength score is already 21 or higher, the potion has no effect.

name: Potion of Heroism
description: For 1 hour after drinking this potion, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points and the effect of the Bless spell. This effect doesn't require Concentration.

name: Potion of Resistance
description: When you drink this potion, you gain Resistance to one type of damage for 1 hour. The DM chooses the type or determines it randomly: Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder.

name: Potion of Water Breathing
description: You can breathe underwater for 1 hour after drinking this potion. Its cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

name: Ring of Feather Falling
description: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

name: Ring of Jumping
description: While wearing this ring, you can cast the Jump spell from it as a Bonus Action at will, but can target only yourself.

name: Ring of Mind Shielding
description: While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it. If you die wearing the ring, your soul can enter it and remain there indefinitely.

name: Ring of Swimming
description: You have a Swim Speed of 40 feet while wearing this ring.

name: Ring of Warmth
description: While wearing this ring, you have Resistance to Cold damage. In addition, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures as low as −50 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Ring of Water Walking
description: While wearing this ring, you can stand on and walk across any liquid surface as if it were solid ground.

name: Robe of Useful Items
description: This robe is covered with cloth patches. While wearing it, you can take a Magic Action to detach one patch, causing it to become the object it represents. The robe comes with patches determined randomly (or by the DM): dagger, bullseye lantern, steel mirror, 10-ft pole, 50 ft hemp rope, sack, 100 gp bag, iron door, 10-ft-cube pit, 24-ft wooden ladder, riding horse, rowboat, random spell scroll, 2 mastiffs, 10×100-gp gems, window, or portable battering ram.

name: Rope of Climbing
description: This 60-foot silk rope (3 lbs, holds 3,000 lbs) animates when you hold one end and take a Magic Action to speak its command word. As a Bonus Action, you can command the other end to move toward a destination you choose. The rope can tie secure knots, untie itself, and coil itself. It has AC 20 and 20 Hit Points, regaining 1 HP every 5 minutes if it has at least 1 HP.

name: Ruby of the War Mage
description: This 1-inch-diameter ruby allows you to use a simple or martial weapon as a spellcasting focus for your spells. To attach the ruby, press it against the weapon for at least 10 minutes. It can't be removed unless you detach it as a Magic Action or the weapon is destroyed.

name: Saddle of the Cavalier
description: While in this saddle, you can't be dismounted against your will if you're conscious, and attack rolls against your mount have Disadvantage.

name: Sending Stones
description: Sending stones come in pairs. While you touch one stone, you can take a Magic Action to cast the Sending spell from it, targeting only the creature bearing the matching stone. If no creature bears the matching stone, you know immediately and don't cast the spell. Each stone can be used once per day.

name: Sentinel Shield
description: While holding this shield, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks. The shield is emblazoned with a stylized eye.

name: Shield of Expression
description: The front of this shield is shaped in the likeness of a face. While bearing the shield, you can use a Bonus Action to alter the face's expression.

name: Slippers of Spider Climbing
description: While you wear these light shoes, you have a Climb Speed equal to your walking Speed and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings while leaving your hands free. The slippers don't function on slippery surfaces such as ice or oil.

name: Smoldering Armor
description: Wisps of harmless, odorless smoke rise from this armor while it is worn.

name: Spell Scroll (1st Level)
description: A spell scroll bears the words of a single 1st-level spell. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll to cast the spell (save DC 13, attack bonus +5) without expending a spell slot; the scroll then crumbles. If not on your class's spell list, make a DC 11 Intelligence (Arcana) check; on a failure, the scroll crumbles.

name: Spell Scroll (2nd Level)
description: A spell scroll bears the words of a single 2nd-level spell. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll to cast the spell (save DC 13, attack bonus +5) without expending a spell slot; the scroll then crumbles. If not on your class's spell list, make a DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana) check; on a failure, the scroll crumbles.

name: Spell Scroll (3rd Level)
description: A spell scroll bears the words of a single 3rd-level spell. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll to cast the spell (save DC 15, attack bonus +7) without expending a spell slot; the scroll then crumbles. If not on your class's spell list, make a DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana) check; on a failure, the scroll crumbles.

name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)
description: A spell scroll bears the words of a single cantrip. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll to cast it without expending a spell slot or material components; the scroll then crumbles. If the spell is not on your class's spell list, make a DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check; on a failure, the scroll crumbles to dust.

name: Staff of Adornment
description: If you place an object weighing no more than 1 pound above the tip of the staff while holding it, the object floats an inch from the staff's tip and remains there until it is removed or until the staff is no longer in your possession. The staff can support up to three such objects at once; while holding it, you can make them slowly spin or turn in place.

name: Staff of Birdcalling
description: This staff has 10 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge and cause it to produce a bird call (finch, raven, duck, chicken, parrot, rook, owl, eagle, or turkey) audible out to 60 feet. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Staff of Flowers
description: This wooden staff has 10 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge and cause a harmless, nonmagical flower to sprout from a patch of earth or soil within 5 feet of you, or from the staff itself. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Stone of Good Luck
description: While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.

name: Sword of Vengeance
description: Cursed. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Curse: once attuned, you are cursed. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons other than this sword. Each time you take damage, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or use your Reaction to attack the creature that damaged you. Only a Remove Curse spell ends the attunement.

name: Talking Doll
description: While this stuffed doll is within 5 feet of you, you can spend a Short Rest telling it up to six sentences. Thereafter, the doll can repeat these sentences out loud whenever it wants, using your voice and intonation. The doll stops repeating when you use this property again.

name: Tankard of Sobriety
description: This tankard has a stern face sculpted into one side. You can drink ale, wine, or any other nonmagical alcoholic beverage poured into it without becoming inebriated. The tankard has no effect on magical beverages or potions.

name: Trident of Fish Command
description: This trident is a magic weapon. It has 3 charges. While you carry it, you can take a Magic Action and expend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast (save DC 15) on a beast that has a Swim Speed. The trident regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Unbreakable Arrow
description: This arrow can't be broken, except when it is within an antimagic field.

name: Veteran's Cane
description: When you grasp this walking cane and use a Bonus Action to speak the command word, it transforms into an ordinary club. Speaking the command word again (no action required) transforms it back into a cane.

name: Walloping Ammunition
description: This ammunition has been enchanted to deliver a particularly powerful impact. When you hit a creature with an attack using this ammunition, the target must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone. Walloping Ammunition can be made in any type of ammunition.

name: Wand of Magic Detection
description: This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge and cast the Detect Magic spell from it. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 or more charges to cast Magic Missile (1 charge = 1st level; each additional charge raises it by one level). The wand regains 1d6 + 1 charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1, the wand crumbles to ashes.

name: Wand of Secrets
description: The wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge; if a secret door or trap is within 30 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you. The wand regains 1d3 charges daily at dawn.

name: Wand of the War Mage, +1
description: While holding this wand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack.

name: Wand of Web
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge and cast the Web spell (save DC 15). The wand regains 1d6 + 1 charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1, the wand crumbles to ashes.

name: Weapon of Warning
description: This magic weapon warns you of danger. While the weapon is on your person, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls. In addition, you and any of your companions within 30 feet of you can't be surprised, except when Incapacitated by something other than nonmagical sleep.

name: Wind Fan
description: While holding this fan, you can take a Magic Action to cast the Gust of Wind spell (save DC 13). Once used, the fan shouldn't be used again until the next dawn. Each time it is used again before then, it has a cumulative 20% chance of not working and tearing into useless, nonmagical tatters.

name: Winged Boots
description: While you wear these boots, you have a Fly Speed equal to your walking Speed. You can fly for up to 4 hours total (minimum 1 minute per use). If flying when the duration expires, you descend at 30 feet per round. The boots regain 2 hours of flying capability for every 12 hours they aren't in use.
